主要内容: The Home Depot reported first-quarter fiscal 2021 sales of $37.5 billion, up 32.7% from $28.3 billion in the same period of fiscal 2020. Comparable sales rose 31.0%, with U.S. comparable sales up 29.9%. Net earnings were $4.1 billion, or $3.86 per diluted share, compared to $2.2 billion, or $2.08 per diluted share, in the prior year. Diluted EPS increased 85.6% year-over-year. The company operates 2,298 retail stores across the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, employing approximately 500,000 associates. The Home Depot's stock is traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: HD). Cash flows from operating activities amounted to $6,310 million, driven by depreciation and amortization of $703 million, stock-based compensation expense of $146 million, and changes in working capital. Cash flows from investing activities totaled $528 million used, primarily due to capital expenditures of $524 million. Financing activities resulted in $7,070 million used, with significant repurchases of common stock and cash dividends. The company's cash and cash equivalents at the end of the period were $6,648 million, reflecting a decrease from $8,696 million in the prior year.
